people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
translations.bsb: And Moses inspected all the work and saw that they had accomplished it just as the LORD had commanded. So Moses blessed them.
